observations: All six alignments and eight distributions were invoked through Photoshop 2026 Layer menus and saved separately from inputs.
Default multi-layer alignment uses nonzero-alpha content bounds for these opaque RGB8 rectangles. Half-pixel alignment displacement rounds toward the larger coordinate, unlike Rust div_euclid(2).
Even spacing sorts by leading edge in the overlap probes, unlike the Rust center ordering; negative gaps are permitted and the last layer is determined by ordering rather than the union maximum.

Align Layers to Selection uses padded storage extent on the tested original imported PSDs. The full-canvas selection left-edge result has visible x=4, not x=0. Bounded selection right-edge result uses observed selection bounds [29,29,112,62].
The default Selection target disables Align for a lone layer without a pixel selection. Explicit Canvas enables Align. Selection presence changes the menu title.
All eight Distribute commands are disabled for two selected layers in the installed app; the documentation’s two-or-more wording does not describe this observed menu state.
No shortcuts are shown for these 14 menu commands. Complete keyboard/preferences parity is unqualified.
All twenty saved operations retain the visible RGBA content hashes; independent recomposition matches 864000 stored merged pixels. This is a reference/model check, not Swift app parity.
Restored Align To Selection, closed all disposable probes and restored the original Paint Bucket tool (Foreground, Normal, 60%, tolerance32); user Untitled-1 remains open without an edited marker.
Step054: six fresh holdouts qualify negative coordinates and Canvas padding against the previously derived model.
A consecutive horizontal-center then full-canvas-selection left alignment requires trimming transparent raster storage after nonzero movement; stationary anchors retain storage padding.

Native composition and PSD export match all 1166400 merged RGBA pixels in 26 single operations plus one sequence. Four live package exports independently match 172800 merged pixels and every layer stored/visible bound/content hash.
560 full and 107 optimized regression tests pass, zero failures/skips; fifteen new layout tests span core/imaging/AppKit.
Live menu, Move/Properties controls, All Layers shortcut, Canvas target, spacing and undo verified. All disposable probes closed; user Photoshop Untitled-1 remains unchanged.

Canvas Solid/Gradient/Pattern Fill layers, including selected groups containing them, explicitly reject layout until bounded/masked semantics are implemented.
